Filmmaker Sudha Kongara seeks unpaid dues, moves Madras High Court

Filmmaker Sudha Kongara has approached the Madras High Court seeking ₹8.39 crore in unpaid dues for directing the movie ‘Parasakthi’. She claims the producers breached their contract and that this legal action is necessary to recover the pending payment. The court has taken steps to address the dispute, including restraining the satellite release of the film.
